name: Jock Studio
source:
For many, college is a once in a lifetime experience, and Olympus University is guaranteed to be a place worth remembering! Olympus U is the most prestigious sports school in the world, known for its athletic programs and award-winning teams. At this all-boys campus, attendees build close-knit communities of classmates and teammates, forming their own circle of friends that last a lifetime.

Experience everything college life has to offer, from creating unforgettable experiences, finding romance in the most unlikely of places... and in this impactful period of life - discovering your sense of purpose!

[From https://www.blitsgames.com/jock-studio/]
translation:
对于许多人来说，大学是一生一次的经历，而奥林巴斯大学一定是一个值得记住的地方！奥林巴斯大学是世界上最负盛名的体育学校，以其体育项目和屡获殊荣的团队而闻名。在这个全是男生的校园里，参与者建立了紧密的同学和队友社区，形成了他们自己的终生朋友圈。

体验大学生活所提供的一切，从创造难忘的经历，在最不可能的地方寻找浪漫……以及在这个人生的影响力时期 - 发现你的使命感！

[来自https://www.blitsgames.com/jock-studio/]
